name: app-layout
purpose: The frame every signed-in product page renders inside. It places named regions — navigation, header, notifications, breadcrumbs, content, tools (the help panel) and the split panel — and owns how they open, close, resize and remember their state. It responds to its **own** width, not the viewport's: below `compactBelow` pixels the navigation and the tools turn into drawers and the split panel moves to the bottom. The regions are slots, so the shell (the `shell/console` block) keeps its own `Sidebar`, `AppHeader` and page content and only hands the frame to `AppLayout`.
useWhen: Use AppLayout only to build a signed-in app shell other than the console; the console uses ConsoleLayout.
A product shell needs a navigation rail, a global header and a scrolling content area that turn into a drawer-based layout on phones.
A page offers contextual help beside the work (`HelpPanel` in the tools region) that the reader opens and closes.
A list or table needs a resizable detail panel under it or beside it (the split panel), showing the selected item without leaving the page.
Page-level flash messages (`Alert`) must sit above the content and stay visible while the content scrolls.
avoidWhen: A single resizable split inside a page, with no shell around it → use `resizable`.
A navigation rail on its own (resize, collapse, footer) → use `sidebar`; put it in the `navigation` slot.
A one-off overlay for a task (a create form, a detail preview) → use `drawer`.
Marketing and documentation pages → use the `shell/site` and `shell/docs` blocks.
related: `sidebar` — the navigation rail that goes in the `navigation` slot; it owns its own width, resize and collapse.
`app-header` — the bar that goes in the `header` slot.
`help-panel` — the content of the tools region.
`drawer` — what the navigation and tools regions become below `compactBelow`.
`resizable` — a split between panes inside a page, without the shell.
`alert` — the flash messages composed into the `notifications` slot.
bestPractices: One `AppLayout` per page, at the root. Do not nest them.

Keep the navigation in the `navigation` slot and read its `drawer` scope flag to drop rail-only controls (resize, collapse) when it renders inside the drawer; call `closeNavigation` from the scope when an item is chosen in the drawer.
Put the control that opens the navigation drawer in the header, and show it only when the header scope's `compact` is true.
Put a help button in the header that calls `toggleTools`; the tools region carries its own close button.
Use the split panel for the selected item of a collection. Close it when the selection clears.
Pass `storageKey` when the reader's choices (split panel size and position, navigation and tools open) should survive a reload.
Flash notifications belong in the `notifications` slot, one `Alert` per message, dismissible. Use toasts for results of actions that finish in the background.

A page body that fills the screen (an empty state, a centred form) is `<main class="flex min-h-full flex-col">` in the default slot. Its height is what is left under the breadcrumbs, so it never scrolls by the breadcrumb row; do not subtract the breadcrumbs yourself.

props.name: navigationAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the navigation drawer. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Navigation`).

props.name: toolsLabel
props.doc: Title of the tools region, shown in its header. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Help`).

props.name: toolsWidth
props.doc: Width of the tools region in pixels while not compact.

props.name: splitPanelTitle
props.doc: Title of the split panel, shown in its header. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Details`).

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: When set, the split panel size and position and the navigation and tools open state are kept in `localStorage` under it.

props.name: compactBelow
props.doc: Width of the layout itself, in pixels, under which navigation and tools become drawers and the split panel moves down.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The page content (the consumer's `<main>`). Fills the content region under the breadcrumbs, so a full-height body (`min-h-full`) takes the rest of the height without overflowing; taller content scrolls.

slots.name: navigation
slots.notes: The navigation rail. Rendered once: beside the content, or inside the navigation drawer when compact. `closeNavigation` closes the drawer, e.g. after an item is chosen.

slots.name: header
slots.scope: { compact: boolean, openNavigation: () => void, toggleNavigation: () => void, toggleTools: () => void }
slots.notes: The global header, above content, tools and split panel.

slots.name: notifications
slots.notes: Flash messages (`Alert`) above the breadcrumbs and the content; stays in place while content scrolls.

slots.name: breadcrumbs
slots.notes: Breadcrumbs above the content, inside the scroll area; the page body fills the height left under them.

slots.name: tools
slots.notes: The tools region's body, usually a `HelpPanel`.
